findings.text: The fast gate is only proven in one direction: every replay sentence is "Smart assistant, …" or a statement, so nothing shows that "Fast assistant, …" still gets a reply (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:1196, replay.mjs SENT). One named sentence in the replay would prove the gate does not also silence the case the owner wants.

`s.fast_heard` is one slot per session (Sessions.js:818, :960), overwritten by each new line; if the fast agent answers an older, named line after a newer unnamed one arrived, its reply is dropped (and the reverse lets one through). Rare at voice speed; keeping the heard text per turn would close it.

`setting_sources: []` (Sessions.js:1051) also drops the project `.mcp.json`, so the smart assistant loses the `site` tools; Servex's own door is still injected by `Agents.door()` (Agents.js:1075), so `spawn_agent` and `quick_fix` keep working. Fine for a voice assistant, but dictate-backend.md's new section could say "no site tools" too.

The spec's top-level `env` (Sessions.js:1051) is not kept in `recipe()` (Agents.js:949-951), so a smart agent reopened from its registry row after a Servex restart comes back with claude.ai connectors on and a larger context. The fast spec already has the same gap; worth one check after the live restart.

Ask 2 is partly met, as next.md:533 says: context 68k to 44k (-35 percent, not half) and cold first reply 6.8 s against the 6 s target (replay-step2a.json). The 46 s "before" (replay-step1.json) is far above the 11.4 s desktop figure recorded earlier, so the size of the speed-up is overstated.

shots/after-sheet.png shows the 60dvh sheet (about 480 of 800 px) but with an empty thread, so "four bubbles show" is a measured height, not a picture of four bubbles; the pngs are also not committed (next.md:541).
Ask 6: no `check_page` result at 400/1200/1920/3440 is in the diff or task.jsonl; `merge.mjs` and the live Servex restart are still the mastermind's to do.
